newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DUFFY MAKES FLYING START AS HIBS MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUFFY MAKES FLYING START AS HIBS MANAGER.

text.p: Jim Duffy made a flying start to his new job as manager of Scottish premier division club Hibernian when he took over on Monday just a few hours after walking out on first division Dundee.
Duffy was flown by helicopter from Dundee to Edinburgh so he would be in time for a mid-morning news conference at which he was formally introduced as Hibernian team boss.
Having said farewell to Dundee officials at the start of the day, Duffy arrived at Hibernian to begin a two-and-a-half year contract and admitted the speed of the appointment surprised him.
"It's not often anybody finds me lost for words and for such an ambitious club as Hibs to offer me the position is something I could only dream about," Duffy said.

Hibernian, sixth in the 10-team division, made the initial approach for Duffy on Friday. A home defeat by Kilmarnock 24 hours earlier effectively ended Jocky Scott's spell as Hibs' caretaker manager following the resignation of Alex Miller at the end of September.
